name: Wing Popup
author: wingdevs

sections.description:
Wing Popup is a powerful yet lightweight WordPress popup builder designed to increase conversions, grow your email list, and improve user engagement. Create beautiful popups, modal windows, and opt-in forms in minutes—without coding.

Whether you want to collect emails, promote offers, or display announcements, Wing Popup gives you full control with advanced targeting, triggers, and seamless Mailchimp integration.

🚀 Key Features

  • Popup Builder: Create unlimited popups using images, HTML, or custom content for marketing, announcements, or lead capture.
  • Mailchimp Integration: Fully integrated Mailchimp forms. Create and manage forms directly from your dashboard and embed them in popups or anywhere using shortcode.
  • Standalone Email Forms: Use Mailchimp forms outside popups in Gutenberg, Elementor, or any page builder via shortcode.
  • Ready-made Templates: Start instantly with 3 professionally designed popup templates. More templates coming soon.
  • Trigger Options: Show popups on page load or trigger them on click for better targeting and engagement.
  • Advanced Display Rules: Show or hide popups on specific pages, posts, or conditions to reach the right audience.
  • Popup Delay & Timing: Control exactly when your popup appears to optimize conversions.
  • Click Trigger Support: Open popups from buttons, links, or any custom element.
  • Full Customization: Adjust size, position, behavior, and styling without writing code.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Built for performance with minimal impact on your site speed.

📈 Perfect For

  • Lead generation and email list building
  • Mailchimp newsletter signup forms
  • Promotions, discounts, and special offers
  • Announcements and alerts
  • Increasing conversions and engagement

💡 Why Choose Wing Popup?

Wing Popup combines simplicity with powerful features. Unlike heavy popup plugins, it stays fast while giving you everything needed to create high-converting popups and email opt-in forms. With built-in Mailchimp integration and ready-made templates, you can launch campaigns in minutes.
sections.installation:
Quick and Easy Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress Dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “Wing Popup”.
  4. Click Install and Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Extract the zip file.
  3. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/.
  4. Activate from the Plugins page.
sections.faq:
1. How many popups can I create?

Unlimited. Create as many popups as you need for your marketing campaigns.

2. Can I use Mailchimp forms without popups?

Yes. You can create Mailchimp forms and use them anywhere via shortcode, including Gutenberg and Elementor.

3. Can I trigger popups on click?

Yes. You can trigger popups from buttons, links, or any custom element.

4. Can I control where popups appear?

Yes. Use advanced display rules to show or hide popups on specific pages or conditions.

5. Can I delay popup display?

Yes. Set custom delays to control when popups appear.

6. Are there ready-made templates?

Yes. The plugin includes 3 ready-made templates to help you get started quickly, with more coming soon.

7. Is it compatible with page builders?

Yes. You can use forms and popups with Gutenberg, Elementor, and other builders.
